import pandas as pd

# Paths to source CSV files
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_16/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_16/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_16/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_16/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_16/training_4.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_16/training_5.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_16/training_6.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_16/training_7.csv",
]

# Read all source files into a list of DataFrames
dfs = [pd.read_csv(f, index_col=0) for f in source_files]

# UNION all source tables (schemas are identical)
df_union = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Ensure columns are in the exact order and types as target schema
target_columns = [
    'movie_display_name',
    'movie_production_year',
    'movie_genre_display_name',
    'movie_financial_summary_production_budget',
    'movie_financial_summary_international_box_office',
    'movie_annual_summary_tickets_sold',
    'movie_video_summary_domestic_dvd_units',
    'movie_acting_role_display_name',
    'movie_theatrical_release_release_date',
    'movie_creative_type_display_name',
    'movie_production_method_display_name',
    'movie_source_display_name',
    'movie_running_time',
    'movie_technical_role_display_name',
    'movie_production_company_display_name',
    'movie_sequel'
]

df = df_union[target_columns].copy()

# Fix data types according to target schema:
# movie_display_name: string
df['movie_display_name'] = df['movie_display_name'].astype(str)

# movie_production_year: integer (some may be float or NaN)
df['movie_production_year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['movie_production_year'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

# movie_genre_display_name: string
df['movie_genre_display_name'] = df['movie_genre_display_name'].astype(str)

# movie_financial_summary_production_budget: integer
df['movie_financial_summary_production_budget'] = pd.to_numeric(df['movie_financial_summary_production_budget'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

# movie_financial_summary_international_box_office: integer
df['movie_financial_summary_international_box_office'] = pd.to_numeric(df['movie_financial_summary_international_box_office'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

# movie_annual_summary_tickets_sold: float
df['movie_annual_summary_tickets_sold'] = pd.to_numeric(df['movie_annual_summary_tickets_sold'], errors='coerce')

# movie_video_summary_domestic_dvd_units: float
df['movie_video_summary_domestic_dvd_units'] = pd.to_numeric(df['movie_video_summary_domestic_dvd_units'], errors='coerce')

# movie_acting_role_display_name: string
df['movie_acting_role_display_name'] = df['movie_acting_role_display_name'].astype(str)

# movie_theatrical_release_release_date: string, ensure format YYYY-MM-DD or empty string if NaN
df['movie_theatrical_release_release_date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['movie_theatrical_release_release_date'], errors='coerce').dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
df['movie_theatrical_release_release_date'] = df['movie_theatrical_release_release_date'].fillna('')

# movie_creative_type_display_name: string
df['movie_creative_type_display_name'] = df['movie_creative_type_display_name'].astype(str)

# movie_production_method_display_name: string
df['movie_production_method_display_name'] = df['movie_production_method_display_name'].astype(str)

# movie_source_display_name: string
df['movie_source_display_name'] = df['movie_source_display_name'].astype(str)

# movie_running_time: float
df['movie_running_time'] = pd.to_numeric(df['movie_running_time'], errors='coerce')

# movie_technical_role_display_name: string
df['movie_technical_role_display_name'] = df['movie_technical_role_display_name'].astype(str)

# movie_production_company_display_name: string
df['movie_production_company_display_name'] = df['movie_production_company_display_name'].astype(str)

# movie_sequel: integer
df['movie_sequel'] = pd.to_numeric(df['movie_sequel'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

# Save the final target table to the specified path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_16/target_multisource.csv"
df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
